description: Main source file for network interface configuration and management in Zephyr OS, including setup of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, interface state handling, and initialization.

methods.name: setup_iface
methods.description: Configures network interface with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and netmask.

methods.name: iface_up_handler
methods.description: Handles interface up event, signals semaphore.

methods.name: wait_for_iface
methods.description: Waits until the network interface is up.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes network interfaces based on device tree nodes.
